description: This file contains helper functions for handling msgpack data structures, specifically for converting, finding components within msgpack maps, and processing responses in a cellular manager context. It includes a primary function 'comp_helper_convert' that unpacks and interprets msgpack-encoded buffers, as well as internal utility functions such as '__finder_comp' to locate specific key-value pairs in msgpack maps.
